blocks.text: MANILA, Philippines — A low pressure area (LPA) being monitored inside the Philippine area of responsibility (PAR) has a low chance of developing into a tropical depression but it will bring rains over parts of the country on Thursday, according to the state weather bureau. In its 5 a.m. weather forecast, the Philippine Atmospheric, Geophysical, and Astronomical Services Administration (Pagasa) said the LPA was last located 125 kilometers east of Puerto Princesa, Palawan, as of 3 a.m. Pagasa weather specialist Obet Badrina said the LPA would bring cloudy skies with scattered rain showers and thunderstorms over the Visayas, Southern Luzon and […]...
